args.title: Fix file name issue with exports in the evening
args.body:
File: src/api/uploads.ts

Ensure that the exported file name reflects the correct date based on the local time zone when the export occurs.

args.title: Correct report duplication naming issue
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Fix the report duplication logic to ensure that copied report names correctly reflect '(copy)' instead of truncating with '...'. This will help users distinguish between original and copied reports.

args.title: Clear upload error message on file change
args.body:
File: src/api/uploads.ts

Update the logic to clear the upload error message immediately when a new file is selected, ensuring users are not misled by stale error messages.
